summary.text: Cathy Osten (Catherine Osten) has represented Connecticut's 19th Senate District since January 2013 and is the Democratic candidate for the seat on the November 3, 2026 ballot.

paragraphs.text: She graduated from Norwich Free Academy in 1973 and then enlisted in the U.S. Army, spending four years in Japan as a translator-interpreter in Mandarin Chinese.
She later attended Mohegan Community College and worked for more than two decades in the state Department of Correction, first as a corrections officer and then as a lieutenant.
